per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP00999 is supported as amolopin/anti-diabetes with paper-level insulin-release evidence, but the database linear sequence omits the source-reported C-terminal amidation; status is sequence_modified_not_normalized and retained as a caution.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The primary source contains no MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity table. Worker-2 recovered source-located insulin-release bioactivity rows from Fig. 2 and marks graphical values as approximate rather than normalized exact assay table values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The only mechanism-probe conclusion supported locally is negative for Ca2+ influx; no antimicrobial or molecular-target mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_final_adjudication: The prior blocking ticket is closed because worker-2/4/6 owner-layer gaps were source-reviewed and gates can be rerun without open rework targets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper reports C-terminal amidation; APD6 sequence field stores the unmodified linear residue string.
Primary activity is insulin release in INS-1 cells; no local primary-source MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity assay was found.
Insulin secretion values were recovered from the figure as approximate visual estimates because no numeric table is available locally.

summary: Source-reviewed re-adjudication verifies amolopin/APD6 AP00999 as an insulinotropic peptide record with cautions for C-terminal amidation loss in the database sequence field, graphical-only Fig. 2 activity values, and absence of primary antimicrobial/toxicity assay rows.
